summary: Mean flow of the shedding Re = 100 cylinder wake, averaged over 25 whole periods; the base flow of stage 315.
description: DNS of the shedding wake (userParam01 = 0) restarted from the t = 100 field of 000_dns, without sponge. 1cyl.usr opens the average at the first upward zero crossing after t = 200 of the integral of v over the domain and closes it 25 crossings later, writes the mean as BFA1cyl0.f00001 and the window as meanflow_window.dat. The period of the shedding is 6.03142 (St = 0.16580, angular frequency 1.0417); the 2D DNS of Marquet & Carini (2020, arXiv:2008.10002) at Re = 100 has the first-harmonic frequency 1.0446, 0.3 % higher. The mean flow has a recirculation bubble of length 1.416 from the rear of the cylinder; the steady flow of 210_baseflow_newton has 6.154. The values below are the regression values of this repository.

n_periods.note: Number of shedding periods in the average. A run that stops at endTime without closing the average has no such file.

period.note: Period from the interpolated upward zero crossings of the integral of v over the domain. The probe at (5, 0) gives 6.03154.

strouhal.note: St = 1 / period, with the cylinder diameter and the free-stream speed as scales.

recirculation_length.note: Distance from the rear of the cylinder (x = 0.5) to the end of the reversed flow on the axis. The steady flow of 210_baseflow_newton/fp has 6.154.

u_min_axis.note: Smallest streamwise velocity on the axis y = 0 (at x = 1.2). The steady flow has -0.2002 at x = 2.8.
